rules.roads: Natural Earth 1:10m roads in the US, sampled every 4 km and snapped to hex-centre links. Class 0: every Interstate. Class 1: other roads at Natural Earth scale rank 6 or less (its most prominent US and state highways) plus every expressway Natural Earth marks as a major highway or beltway, where no Interstate already joins the same two hexes.
rules.rail: Natural Earth 1:10m railroads at scale rank 7 or less, sampled every 4 km and snapped to hex-centre links; tier 0 (main line) is scale rank 5 or less. Lines in Canada and Mexico are clipped. Natural Earth holds about half of the real US rail network and carries no owner or traffic data.
rules.ports: The USACE principal ports by total tonnage (short tons). Each is a port statistical area, placed at the area's centroid, so long river ports are approximate.
rules.airports: Every primary airport (FAA hub class large, medium, small or nonhub: 10,000+ boardings a year) and every airport in FAA's all-cargo table, placed by FAA location id with the NASR airport master.
